final_answer:
Let
\[
q_\tau(x)=\frac12x^TA_\tau x+b^Tx.
\]
For the trust-region problem, a global minimizer \(x\) is characterized by the existence of \(\lambda\ge0\) such that
\[
(A_\tau+\lambda I)x=-b,\qquad A_\tau+\lambda I\succeq0,\qquad \lambda(\|x\|^2-1)=0.
\]
Since \(e_1^TA_\tau e_1=-3<0\), the minimizer is on the boundary, so \(\lambda>0\).

Nonuniqueness can occur only in the hard case: \(A_\tau+\lambda I\) is singular positive semidefinite and its null vector is orthogonal to \(b\). Write \(r=\lambda\), and let \(v=(v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4)\neq0\) span the nullspace. From
\[
(A_\tau+rI)v=0
\]
we may take \(v_1=1\), giving
\[
v_2=3-r,\qquad v_3=r^2-3r-1,\qquad v_4=-\frac{r^2-3r-1}{r+4}.
\]
The orthogonality condition \(b^Tv=v_2+v_3+v_4=0\) becomes
\[
(3-r)+(r^2-3r-1)-\frac{r^2-3r-1}{r+4}=0,
\]
equivalently
\[
r^3-r^2-11r+9=0.
\]
Using the remaining null-vector equation together with \(b^Tv=0\) gives
\[
\tau=1-r.
\]
Thus \(\tau\) must satisfy
\[
(1-\tau)^3-(1-\tau)^2-11(1-\tau)+9=0,
\]
or
\[
\tau^3-2\tau^2-10\tau+2=0.
\]

On the interval \(\left[-\frac52,-\frac{17}{7}\right]\),
\[
f(\tau)=\tau^3-2\tau^2-10\tau+2
\]
is strictly increasing because
\[
f'(\tau)=3\tau^2-4\tau-10>0
\]
there. Also
\[
f\!\left(-\frac52\right)=-\frac98<0,\qquad
f\!\left(-\frac{17}{7}\right)=\frac{57}{343}>0.
\]
So there is exactly one such parameter.

At this parameter, put \(r=1-\tau_*\). Then
\[
A_{\tau_*}+rI=
\begin{pmatrix}
r-3&1&0&0\\
1&r&1&0\\
0&1&1&1\\
0&0&1&r+4
\end{pmatrix}
\succeq0
\]
with determinant \(0\), and
\[
x_0=(0,0,-1,0)^T
\]
satisfies
\[
(A_{\tau_*}+rI)x_0=-b,\qquad \|x_0\|=1.
\]
All minimizers are of the form \(x_0+sv\) on the unit sphere. Since \(v_3=r^2-3r-1>0\), the equation \(\|x_0+sv\|=1\) has exactly two solutions:
\[
s=0,\qquad s=\frac{2v_3}{\|v\|^2}.
\]
Hence \(|\mathcal X_{\tau_*}|=2\), while for every other \(\tau\) in the interval the hard-case condition fails, so \(\mathcal X_\tau\) is a singleton.

Finally,
\[
m(\tau_*)=q_{\tau_*}(x_0)=\frac12\tau_*-1.
\]

\[
\boxed{\tau_*=\operatorname{root}_{(-5/2,\,-17/7)}\!\left(t^3-2t^2-10t+2\right)}
\]
